301.DSCR:
A type of $$デイモーン$$ used by $$サイデリアル$$ for maintaining public order.
It differs in coloring and some of its armament, and its main mission is suppressing rioters.
Because of its inorganic appearance and merciless methods, the people of Earth call it the 'Police Bat' and loathe it.

302.DSCR:
The latest mass-produced mobile weapon used by $$サイデリアル$$.
It is basically an unmanned unit, controlled by AI.
Compared with the $$デイモーン$$, which follows the same concept, its firepower and durability have been greatly improved, and its overall combat strength rivals that of the standard-issue $$アンゲロイ$$.
It is basically deployed to the battlefield together with the $$デイモーン$$, but with the quality of this high-performance unit added to a tactic of overwhelming numbers, the ranks of $$サイデリアル$$ became incomparably deeper than they had been during the $$時獄戦役$$.

303.DSCR:
An autonomous mobile turret.
Its mobility is low, but it boasts long range and excels at defending strongholds.
It was originally a weapon manufactured on Earth, but $$サイデリアル$$ seized the entire production line, made improvements to it, and now uses it as an inexpensive force.

305.DSCR:
A mobile weapon that the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation had been developing as its next flagship product.
Whereas the $$アクシオ$$, the Foundation's flagship product and a best-selling model, is primarily for ground combat, this unit focuses on aerial combat in order to compete with other companies' products.
Its armament was also switched from ballistic weapons to optical weapons, and it was designed with next-generation combat in mind.
After the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation was dissolved, the development line was halted, but another company that had bought the design had started mass production.
$$サイデリアル$$ seized those production lines and mass-produced it in large numbers, deploying it to the front lines mainly under AI control.

306.DSCR:
A multipurpose machine used mainly on $$翠の地球$$.
It was used not only for combat but also for civil engineering, underwater work and more, and is well regarded for its power, ease of maintenance and frame strength.
No dedicated hand-held armament is provided, but it can use a variety of weapons as long as the manipulator standard matches.
$$サイデリアル$$ seized the production lines and mass-produced it in large numbers, deploying it to the front lines mainly under AI control.

307.DSCR:
A mobile weapon developed and sold by the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation.
Its sales channels were extensive: it was not only formally adopted by the militaries of small nations without weapons development technology of their own, but was also used by mercenary organizations and even terrorists, and it has many variations.
It is characterized by good handling, high versatility and abundant optional weapons. Its highly automated control system can also be run by AI, so it can be used as an unmanned unit.
On the other hand, although its performance clears a certain standard, its shortcomings have been pointed out as pilots' skills improve.
Even after the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation was dismantled, it continued to be produced and sold by companies that acquired licenses, but since upgrades are out of the question, it is gradually giving up its place as a mainstay to other weapons.
Now it is mass-produced by $$サイデリアル$$, which seized the production lines, and is deployed to the front mainly under AI control.

308.DSCR:
A mobile weapon piloted by $$尸空#pilot$$, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$.
Its name is read '$$尸逝天$$.'
It has the appearance of the corpse of a huge creature, and dominates the atmosphere of the battlefield together with the silent pressure of its pilot, $$尸空#pilot$$.
It has high firepower and can attack multiple targets simultaneously.
308.DSC2:
A mobile weapon piloted by $$尸空#pilot$$, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$.
Its name is read '$$尸逝天$$.'
It has the appearance of the corpse of a huge creature, and dominates the atmosphere of the battlefield together with the silent pressure of its pilot, $$尸空#pilot$$.
It has high firepower and can attack multiple targets simultaneously.
Its true nature is the remains of a creature that dwells between life and death and can cross the boundary between the two, a being that transcends the natural order by continuing to exist even after death.
When armor and other components are attached to its offspring, it becomes a $$尸冥爪$$.
It has stayed with the successive chiefs of $$鬼宿$$, who, though living beings, govern the 'force that seeks to vanish,' and is now owned by $$尸刻$$, the current head of $$鬼宿$$.
After being defeated in the decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$, it offered up its $$スフィア$$ together with $$尸空#pilot$$, who had entrusted the defeat of the $$御使い$$ to $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$, and departed for the far reaches of the causal horizon.

309.DSCR:
A mobile weapon used by $$鬼宿$$, a special unit belonging to the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
Its name is read '$$尸冥爪$$.'
It is not a pure machine but a semi-biological weapon made by incorporating armor and other components into a special creature.
Its control also uses a special thought-control system unlike any other, and it can only be operated by people of $$鬼宿$$.
Its thick armor and unique method of movement make it excel at defense and evasion, and at the same time it excels at attacks that take advantage of its charging power, giving it high combat strength.
Records of its existence from the distant past remain in the history of the galaxy, but few have ever seen it, and even within $$サイデリアル$$ its true nature, like the existence of $$鬼宿$$ itself, is shrouded in mystery.

311.DSCR:
A battleship piloted by $$ストラウス$$, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$欲深な金牛$$.
As the flagship of $$ストラウス$$, who serves as commander of all the forces of the $$新地球皇国$$, it is also the flagship of the Empire.
Its basic design is the same as the $$アルデバル$$ piloted by $$ハイアデス$$, but thanks to the power of the $$スフィア$$ it carries and the skill of $$ストラウス$$, it boasts breakthrough power and offensive power that overwhelm all others.
Its overwhelming presence, shining gold, together with the command ability of $$ストラウス$$, is a symbol of victory for $$サイデリアル$$ and is very popular even with front-line soldiers other than $$ハイアデス$$.
311.DSC2:
A battleship piloted by $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$欲深な金牛$$.
As the flagship of $$エルーナルーナ$$, who serves as commander of all the forces of the $$新地球皇国$$, it is also the flagship of the Empire.
Its basic design is the same as the $$アルデバル$$ piloted by $$ハイアデス$$, but thanks to the power of the $$スフィア$$ it carries and the skill of $$エルーナルーナ$$, it boasts breakthrough power and offensive power that overwhelm all others.
Its overwhelming presence, shining gold, together with the command ability of $$エルーナルーナ$$, is a symbol of victory for $$サイデリアル$$ and is very popular even with front-line soldiers other than $$ハイアデス$$.
It was originally a customized $$アルデバル$$ that the previous leader of $$ハイアデス$$, a combat group wandering the galaxy, gave to his daughter $$エルーナルーナ$$, and it carried the $$スフィア$$ of the $$欲深な金牛$$, before its awakening, as its power source.
When $$サイデリアル$$ took $$ハイアデス$$ under its command, $$エルーナルーナ$$ lost her father to them, but at the words of $$アウストラリス$$ promising to provide a place for still more fighting, she awakened the $$スフィア$$ of the $$欲深な金牛$$.
While affirming herself for having been unable to suppress the surge of her blood, $$エルーナルーナ$$ swore before $$プレイアデス・タウラ$$, which had become her father's keepsake, to defeat the $$御使い$$.
After being defeated in the decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$, it perished together with $$エルーナルーナ$$ in order to offer its $$スフィア$$ to $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$, as had long been promised.

312.DSCR:
A battleship used by $$ハイアデス$$, a special unit belonging to the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
$$ハイアデス$$ members link their own bodies directly to each control system and operate the ship, literally like their own limbs, each all by themselves. Through this union of person and ship, it displays mobility and maneuverability extraordinary for a battleship and is operated in the same way as a mobile weapon.
Premised on combat in the galactic sea, it is best at a tactic of raining down high-firepower bombardment as soon as an enemy is spotted at long range, and launching a charge if that fails to shoot the enemy down. However, many $$ハイアデス$$ members prefer close combat and enjoy the thrill of deliberately leaping into the enemy's combat range.
Thanks to its sturdy armor, heavy firepower and coordination among the members, the name of $$ハイアデス$$, who commanded fleets of $$アルデバル$$, once thundered across the galactic sea.

313.DSCR:
A customized version of the $$アルデバル$$ used by $$ハイアデス$$, a special unit belonging to the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$, modified by $$ダバラーン$$.
$$ハイアデス$$ members link their own bodies directly to each control system and operate the ship, literally like their own limbs, each all by themselves. Through this union of person and ship, it displays mobility and maneuverability extraordinary for a battleship and is operated in the same way as a mobile weapon.
Premised on combat in the galactic sea, it is best at a tactic of raining down high-firepower bombardment as soon as an enemy is spotted at long range, and launching a charge if that fails to shoot the enemy down. However, many $$ハイアデス$$ members prefer close combat and enjoy the thrill of deliberately leaping into the enemy's combat range.
$$ダバラーン$$ has this tendency most strongly, and has customized it to suit a charging tactic by reinforcing the frontal armor and propulsion.

314.DSCR:
A mobile weapon piloted by $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$, the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$.
The huge back unit '$$ブランダイ$$' is a control system for multipurpose nanomachines, and $$バルビエル$$ excels at attacking while bewildering the enemy by making full use of it and the mobility of the $$アン・アーレス$$.
The nanomachines are strengthened by the $$スフィア$$ of the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, and can even adhere to the outside of a unit to directly damage its pilot.
The unit itself also controls the $$スフィア$$ at a high level, and boasts power and durability unimaginable from its slender appearance.
Note that the crystal covering the left side of its face was born of the awakening of the $$スフィア$$ and is not part of its original equipment.

After being defeated in the decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$, it was completely destroyed by $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$ in order to take its $$スフィア$$.

315.DSCR:
A mobile weapon used by $$アンタレス$$, a special unit belonging to the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
It has sturdy armor and special armament, closes in on the enemy, and damages both the enemy unit and its pilot.
It was developed at the same time as the formation of $$アンタレス$$, and is one of the relatively new units within $$サイデリアル$$.
On every front it was an object of terror together with the name of $$アンタレス$$, and its very existence was feared and loathed beyond its simple combat strength.

The leader's unit of the $$シャウラス$$ used by $$アンタレス$$, a special unit belonging to the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.

317.DSCR:
The true form of $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, whose identity as a $$次元将$$ has been revealed.
The equipment corresponding to what $$ヴィシュラカーラ$$ is for $$ガイオウ$$ has been lost, but combining the power of a $$次元将$$ with the $$スフィア$$ of the $$立ち上がる射手$$ that he holds himself and the power of the three $$スフィア$$s he has absorbed produces transcendent combat strength.
Also, in control of phenomena by $$次元力$$, he far surpasses $$ガイオウ$$.

318.DSCR:
A $$次元獣$$ created by $$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$.
As it falls outside the $$インサラウム$$-style classification, it does not carry the name '$$ダモン$$.'
It is an aerial-combat type $$次元獣$$ with excellent mobility.
Its overall combat strength is at least that of the $$真次元獣ディノダモン$$ that appeared in the final battle with the $$破界の王$$, $$ガイオウ$$, and from this and some of its armament, it is presumed to be in a state midway between the golden-glowing 'True $$次元獣$$' and ordinary '$$次元獣$$.'

319.DSCR:
The $$ゼル・ビレニウム$$ that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ gave to the artificial life forms, the $$ネオ・リアクター$$, that he had created himself.
There are twelve in all, each equipped with a pseudo-$$スフィア$$ corresponding to one of the twelve zodiac constellations, and thanks to the abilities of the $$ネオ・リアクター$$, who were made solely to draw out the power of the $$スフィア$$s, they can also use $$スフィア・アクト$$.
They appeared in the waters near Earth, which had become the end of myth, to guard the $$至高神Ｚ$$.

320.DSCR:
A ship used by the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
It also serves as a carrier, loading many mobile weapons into its large-capacity payload.
At the same time it excels in firepower against targets to its front; its main gun, the '$$メーザーシュート$$,' can fire in all directions, and focusing that fire in a single direction produces high offensive power.
As it is a genuine $$サイデリアル$$ weapon, it is not committed to peripheral battlefields, and the people who serve as its captain are limited to those of considerable standing within $$サイデリアル$$.

321.DSCR:
A transport ship developed and sold by the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation.
It can be used both inside and outside the atmosphere, and because its container section can be configured flexibly, it is easy to use and was widely in use.
Though minimal, it is also armed and can be used in combat.
It was mass-produced by $$サイデリアル$$, which seized the production lines, and is deployed to the front lines.

322.DSCR:
A humanoid mobile weapon piloted by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.
It has high mobility and a well-balanced arsenal, and combined with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s own piloting skill, it can bring its full strength to bear in any situation.
The circumstances of its development remain shrouded in mystery, but $$次元力$$ is used in some form as its power source, and its output and control over phenomena are on a level comparable to $$スフィア$$-equipped units.
The $$クロノ$$ Reformists use a mass-produced version of this unit, and it too boasts high combat strength.

323.DSCR:
The true form of the $$アスクレプス$$ piloted by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.
Bearing the name of the sun god, it displays overwhelming power beyond human comprehension.
It is a sacred treasure created from the core of $$至高神ソル$$ when it shattered 12,000 years ago, and was given as a final mercy to $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, who had been exiled from the $$御使い$$.
Its grandeur brings tears to the faint of heart, gives despair to the powerless, and gives absolute defeat to those who defy it.
It is one of the keys to resurrecting $$至高神ソル$$, and $$ドクトリン$$, seeking the existence of $$ヘリオース$$ in order to get through the great collapse of the universe, permitted the return of $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.

324.DSCR:
A humanoid mobile weapon used by the action units of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.
It carries nearly the same armament as the $$アスクレプス$$ it is based on, and boasts high performance. In addition, it has good handling, which allows even the $$クロノ$$ members, who are not accustomed to real combat, to fight on the front lines.

325.DSCR:
A jet-black humanoid mobile weapon piloted by $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.
It boasts tremendous maneuverability and confounds enemies with its speed. Its main weapon is the '$$魔王剣・ディスキャリバー$$.' It can also transform into a high-speed cruising form. A perpetual motion engine is built in as its main power source, and it displays various unique abilities, but the technology used and the circumstances of its development are shrouded in mystery.

A perpetual motion engine is built in as its main power source, and it displays various unique abilities, but the technology used and the circumstances of its development are shrouded in mystery.

A form of the $$シュロウガ$$ evolved by $$アサキム$$, who absorbed four $$スフィア$$s and mastered the flow of the Power of Origin.
Its name means 'one who has piled up sins.'
Its jet-black wings produce maneuverability and speed surpassing the $$シュロウガ$$, and its attacks sever even causality, banishing those they strike from the wheel of reincarnation.

A form of the $$シュロウガ$$ evolved by $$アサキム$$, who absorbed four $$スフィア$$s and mastered the flow of the Power of Origin.
Its name means 'one who has piled up sins.'
Its jet-black wings produce maneuverability and speed surpassing the $$シュロウガ$$, and its attacks sever even causality, banishing those they strike from the wheel of reincarnation.
The $$シュロウガ$$, a system that manipulates the law of causality, absorbed four $$スフィア$$s, and with $$アサキム$$ becoming the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of each, it nearly regained the power it originally possessed and displayed overwhelming power beyond human comprehension.

327.DSCR:
A mobile weapon under the direct command of the $$御使い$$.
Its entire body is composed of $$ＤＥＣ$$ (Dimension Energy Crystal / Dimensional Crystal), and its operation and armament are all powered by the Power of Origin.
It is mainly piloted by $$イドム$$, a spirit-form being, who turns craving for a body and for life directly into power to attack the living. It boasts combat strength greater than the $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$, and it was this unit that defeated $$エルーナルーナ$$'s father, the previous leader of $$ハイアデス$$.
In addition, one to three are sent to each star watched over by the $$御使い$$; each awakens when that star begins to go down a path of evolution against the will of the $$御使い$$, and has the role of destroying its civilization. It is feared in galactic legend under the name 'Giant Beast of Judgment.'
Incidentally, the $$次元獣$$s used by the Dimensional Generals were developed using this unit as a model.

328.DSCR:
The strongest unit among the forces under the direct command of the $$御使い$$.
Its entire body is composed of $$ＤＥＣ$$ (Dimension Energy Crystal / Dimensional Crystal), and its operation and armament are all powered by the Power of Origin.
Thanks to its sturdy armor and offensive power, about two of them can annihilate the military of a planet of average civilization capable of interstellar travel in the Milky Way galaxy.
Only 666 exist in the entire universe, and only especially chosen individuals among the $$真徒$$ are permitted to board, which they consider the highest honor.
It is even rarer than the $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$ and the $$エル・ミレニウム$$ for it to be committed to the battle lines of the ordinary universe, and in these 12,000 years it has been dispatched to the ordinary universe only twice.

329.DSCR:
A mobile fortress boarded by $$ドクトリン$$ and $$テンプティ$$.
$$テンプティ$$ is an irresponsible bystander, and $$ドクトリン$$ handles the actual control.
It bears the name 'Miracle' and displays overwhelming power beyond human comprehension.
It is a sacred treasure created from the empty shell of $$至高神ソル$$ when it shattered 12,000 years ago, and inherited the embers of Sol together with the $$黒い太陽#sol$$.
Its grandeur destroys the ego of the faint of heart, brings fear to the powerless, and delivers the punishment of condemnation on those who defy it.
Together with $$ヘリオース$$ and the $$黒い太陽#sol$$, it is a key to resurrecting $$至高神ソル$$, but even the $$プロディキウム$$ alone can, though with conditions, produce enough Power of Origin to destroy a galaxy.

After being defeated by the people of Earth in the decisive battle in $$カオス・コスモス$$, it was used in the rite of rebirth by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, who sought to become the Supreme God by absorbing the other three $$御使い$$s.

330.DSCR:
The supreme and strongest existence, transcending the causality of all universes.
The original Supreme God was supposed to be reborn when twelve $$スフィア$$s were offered to the three sacred treasures, $$ヘリオース$$, $$プロディキウム$$ and the $$黒い太陽#sol$$, but $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ used four eternal lives, $$ドクトリン$$, $$テンプティ$$, $$サクリファイ$$ and $$アサキム$$, in place of the four missing $$スフィア$$s, and completed the Supreme God that he desired.
It was given the name 'Z' as 'the one who sees off the end of the old world.'
It controls both the 'force that seeks to exist' called eternity and the 'force that seeks to vanish' called the death of others, and by itself governs enough Power of Origin to destroy a galaxy.
It is a being that cannot be measured by the yardstick of combat strength, and ordinary weapons that have not achieved true-evolution fusion cannot deal any damage to it at all.
According to the words of $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, it is the only existence able to survive the great collapse of the universe that occurs once every 120 million years, and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ intended to begin anew the world of his ideal from a world of zero, where everything has vanished.
